result.instructions: Tools for HotelRunner, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which reservations came in over the last 7 days, and from which channels?"; "Show reservation R377873409 with its payments and guest note."; "Close the Standard Room for sale on 24-26 December.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes HotelRunner data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run hotelrunner_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run hotelrunner_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run hotelrunner_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. hotelrunner_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: hotelrunner_list_rooms
tools.title: List rooms and rates
tools.description: List the property's room types and rates with their inv_code and rate_code, capacity, pricing type, sales currency, connected channel codes and whether availability, restrictions and prices can be updated through the API. Use the inv_code with hotelrunner_update_room_calendar. Counts as one of the property's 250 requests per day (5 per minute). GET /api/v2/apps/rooms.

tools.name: hotelrunner_list_reservations
tools.title: List reservations
tools.description: List reservations of the property (new, modified, canceled), newest data first as HotelRunner returns them, 1-50 per page. By default ALL reservations created in the window are returned (this tool sets undelivered=false, so reading does not depend on a PMS having fetched them). from_date is the creation date (HotelRunner keeps at most 30 days back; default 10 days); from_last_update_date finds reservations changed since a date. detail 'summary' (default) gives guest, dates, rooms, totals, payment state and contact; 'full' returns the whole vendor record including billing address, national id, daily prices and extras. Reply: items, count, page, pages, next_page. Counts as one of the property's 250 requests per day (5 per minute). GET /api/v2/apps/reservations.

from_date.description: Only reservations created on/after this date, yyyy-mm-dd (max 30 days back; default 10 days back).

from_last_update_date.description: Only reservations updated on/after this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: hotelrunner_get_reservation
tools.title: Get reservation
tools.description: One reservation by its HotelRunner code (hr_number, e.g. R377873409) or the sales channel's own reservation code, with the full vendor record (rooms, daily prices, extras, payments, guest and billing details, next_states). If the reservation is older than HotelRunner's lookup window, pass from_date. Counts as one of the property's 250 requests per day (5 per minute). GET /api/v2/apps/reservations?reservation_number=.

reservation_number.description: HotelRunner reservation code (hr_number, e.g. R377873409) or the sales channel's reservation code.

from_date.description: Creation-date window start, yyyy-mm-dd (HotelRunner keeps at most 30 days back).

tools.name: hotelrunner_list_channels
tools.title: List sales channels
tools.description: All sales channels HotelRunner supports (name and code, e.g. bookingcom, expedia, hrs, online). The code is what hotelrunner_update_room_calendar takes in channel_codes. Counts as one of the property's 250 requests per day (5 per minute). GET /api/v2/apps/infos/channels.

tools.name: hotelrunner_list_connected_channels
tools.title: List connected channels
tools.description: The channels this property is connected to, each with counts of calendar update processes in progress, succeeded and failed. Counts as one of the property's 250 requests per day (5 per minute). GET /api/v2/apps/infos/connected_channels.

tools.name: hotelrunner_get_transaction_details
tools.title: Get calendar update status
tools.description: Per-channel status of a calendar update: pass the transaction_id returned by hotelrunner_update_room_calendar. Shows succeeded / failed / in-progress counts and each channel's state and error message. Counts as one of the property's 250 requests per day (5 per minute). GET /api/v2/apps/infos/transaction_details.

tools.name: hotelrunner_update_room_calendar
tools.title: Update room availability, prices and restrictions
tools.description: WRITE: change availability, price, minimum/maximum stay, stop-sale, closed-to-arrival (cta) or closed-to-departure (ctd) for ONE room type (inv_code) over a date range of at most 90 days, optionally only on some weekdays and only on some channels. Only the fields you pass are changed. This is LIVE inventory: HotelRunner pushes it to every connected channel (Booking.com, Expedia, your own booking engine, ...) and it changes what guests can book and pay. The price is the base-rate price in the property's sales currency; guest-based prices derive from it. Only rooms whose availability_update / restrictions_update / price_update flag is true (hotelrunner_list_rooms) accept that kind of change. HotelRunner answers asynchronously: the reply has a transaction_id; check per-channel results with hotelrunner_get_transaction_details. Send one change per call, not a full refresh. Counts as one of the property's 250 requests per day (5 per minute). PUT /api/v2/apps/rooms/daily.

inv_code.description: An inventory code from hotelrunner_list_rooms, e.g. HR:1903.

price.description: Base nightly price in the property's sales currency.

stop_sale.description: true = close the room for sale on these dates, false = reopen.

days.description: Only these weekdays, 0 = Sunday ... 6 = Saturday (default: every day).

channel_codes.description: Only these channels (codes from hotelrunner_list_connected_channels); default: all connected channels of the room.

annotations.title: Update room availability, prices and restrictions

tools.name: hotelrunner_update_reservation_state
tools.title: Confirm or cancel a reservation
tools.description: WRITE: move ONE reservation to the next state: event 'confirm' (hotelier accepts it) or 'cancel' (cancels it; cancel_reason is required: customer, no_room, no_show or invalid_price). Cancel is not reversible through this API and releases the room; HotelRunner may notify the guest or the sales channel (Booking.com, Expedia, ...), so only cancel when the user clearly asked for it, and pass confirm=true for a cancel. Only possible when the reservation's requires_response is true and the event is in its next_states (see hotelrunner_get_reservation); otherwise HotelRunner answers state_change_is_not_available. Counts as one of the property's 250 requests per day (5 per minute). PUT /api/v2/apps/reservations/fire.

cancel_reason.description: Required for cancel: customer, no_room, no_show or invalid_price.

confirm.description: Required true for event 'cancel': the user explicitly approved cancelling this reservation (not reversible).
